pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT CustomerId FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY City, Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) AS T1

question: What is the maximum number of line items on any single invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId)
pred_sql: SELECT MAX(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine

question: As of 2025-01-01, how many whole years had each employee worked? Compute it as the number of days since hire divided by 365.25, truncated. Return first name, last name, and years.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, CAST((julianday('2025-01-01') - julianday(HireDate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) FROM Employee
pred_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, TRUNC((julianday('2025-01-01') - julianday(HireDate)) / 365.25) AS YearsWorked FROM Employee

question: How many tracks were purchased by more than one different customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceLine.TrackId FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId GROUP BY InvoiceLine.TrackId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Invoice.CustomerId) > 1)
pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine WHERE TrackId IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) > 1)

question: What is the average number of invoice lines per invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId)
pred_sql: SELECT AVG(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine

question: What percentage of customers have spent more than 40 in total? Return a number from 0 to 100.
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)
pred_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Total > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Invoice

question: How many customers have purchased at least one 'Latin' track but no 'Jazz' track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT Invoice.CustomerId FROM Invoice JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.InvoiceId = Invoice.InvoiceId JOIN Track ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId JOIN Genre ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Latin' EXCEPT SELECT Invoice.CustomerId FROM Invoice JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.InvoiceId = Invoice.InvoiceId JOIN Track ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId JOIN Genre ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz')
pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.GenreId = (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Latin') AND i.CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT i2.CustomerId FROM Invoice i2 JOIN InvoiceLine il2 ON i2.InvoiceId = il2.InvoiceId JOIN Track t2 ON il2.TrackId = t2.TrackId WHERE t2.GenreId = (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Jazz'))

question: Which playlists contain tracks of more than 2 distinct media types? Return playlist name.
gold_sql: SELECT Playlist.Name FROM Playlist JOIN PlaylistTrack ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId JOIN Track ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId, Playlist.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Track.MediaTypeId) > 2
pred_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 JOIN Playlist AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T1.TrackId = T3.TrackId GROUP BY T2.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.MediaTypeId) > 2

question: What was the total invoice revenue in 2023 for each support representative's customers? Return first name, last name, and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName, SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Employee JOIN Customer ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    e.FirstName, 
    e.LastName, 
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Employee e
JOIN 
    Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
JOIN 
    Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE 
    i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    e.EmployeeId;

question: Among billing countries with at least 5 invoices, which has the highest average invoice total? Return country and average.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS a FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1
pred_sql:
SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageTotal
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY AverageTotal DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks cost more than the average price of tracks in their own genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE t.UnitPrice > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track WHERE GenreId = t.GenreId)
pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE UnitPrice > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK WHERE GenreId = TRACK.GenreId)

question: What are the 3 longest albums by total track duration? Return album title and total minutes (milliseconds divided by 60000.0), longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT Album.Title, SUM(Track.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS m FROM Album JOIN Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 3
pred_sql: SELECT T1.Title, SUM(T2.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS TotalMinutes FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId GROUP BY T1.AlbumId ORDER BY TotalMinutes DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the difference between the highest and the lowest yearly total invoice revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(s) - MIN(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate))
pred_sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice) - (SELECT MIN(Total) FROM Invoice) AS RevenueDifference

question: How many distinct composers have at least one track that has been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Track.Composer) FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId WHERE Track.Composer IS NOT NULL
pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Composer) FROM Track WHERE TrackId IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: For each support representative, how many distinct customers do they have and how many invoices do those customers have in total? Return first name, last name, customer count, and invoice count.
gold_sql: SELECT Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT Customer.CustomerId), COUNT(Invoice.InvoiceId) FROM Employee JOIN Customer ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName
pred_sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount, SUM(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;

question: How many customers share their first name with at least one other customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Customer d WHERE d.FirstName = c.FirstName AND d.CustomerId <> c.CustomerId)
pred_sql: SELECT FirstName FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY FirstName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Which 5 albums generated the most revenue (UnitPrice times Quantity)? Return album title and revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT Album.Title, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS r FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId JOIN Album ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5
pred_sql:
SELECT T3.Title, SUM(T2.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine AS T2
JOIN Invoice AS T1 ON T2.InvoiceId = T1.InvoiceId
JOIN Track AS T4 ON T2.TrackId = T4.TrackId
JOIN Album AS T3 ON T4.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId
GROUP BY T3.AlbumId
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
